desc: Decompose $S$ into primitive components using a stack-based approach.
For each component, compute its "reverse" $C'$ (reverse string and swap '(' with ')').
Classify components into "fixed" ($C = C'$) and "variable" ($C \neq C'$).
Prepare lists of polynomial factors: fixed factors are $x^{|C|}/|C|!$, variable factors are $(x^{|A|}/|A|! + x^{|B|}/|B|!)$.
Group identical polynomial factors to optimize multiplication.
Compute the product of all polynomial factors using binary exponentiation for groups of identical factors.
Extract the coefficient of $x^N$ from the resulting polynomial.
Multiply the coefficient by $N!$ modulo 998244353 and print the result.
Run the provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
Check edge cases (e.g., $N=2$, all fixed, all variable).
Ensure the modulo arithmetic is correctly applied at each step.
